## Brass Dragon, Mature Adult (CR 12)

**XP** 19,200  
CG Large dragon (fire)  
**Init** +5; **Senses** blindsense 60 ft., dragon senses; Perception +26; **Aura** frightful presence (210 ft., DC 20)  


**Defense**


**AC** 31, touch 10, flat-footed 30 (+1 Dex, +21 natural, –1 size)  
**hp** 272 (16d12+80)  
**Fort** +15, **Ref** +11, **Will** +13  
**DR** 10/magic; **Immune** fire, paralysis, sleep; **SR** 23  
**Weaknesses** vulnerability to cold  


**Offense**


**Speed** 60 ft., burrow 30 ft., fly 200 ft. (poor)  
**Melee** bite +24 (2d6+12), 2 claws +23 (1d8+8), 2 wings +21 (1d6+4), tail slap +21 (1d8+12)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft. (15 ft. with bite)  
**Special Attacks** breath weapon (80-ft. line, DC 23, 14d4 fire), desert wind, sleep breath  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 16th; concentration +19)  

At will—*[endure elements](../../magic/spells/endure-elements.md)*, *[speak with animals](../../magic/spells/speak-with-animals.md)*, *[suggestion](../../magic/spells/suggestion.md)* (DC 16)  

**Sorcerer Spells Known** (CL 9th; concentration +12)  

4th (4/day)—*[charm monster](../../magic/spells/charm-monster.md)* (DC 19), *[confusion](../../magic/spells/confusion.md)* (DC 19)  
3rd (7/day)—*[displacement](../../magic/spells/displacement.md)*, *[hold person](../../magic/spells/hold-person.md)* (DC 18), *[tongues](../../magic/spells/tongues.md)*  
2nd (7/day)—*[alter self](../../magic/spells/alter-self.md)*, *[detect thoughts](../../magic/spells/detect-thoughts.md)* (DC 15), *[resist energy](../../magic/spells/resist-energy.md)*, *[see invisibility](../../magic/spells/see-invisibility.md)*  
1st (7/day)—*[alarm](../../magic/spells/alarm.md)*, *[charm person](../../magic/spells/charm-person.md)* (DC 16), *[protection from evil](../../magic/spells/protection-from-evil.md)*, *[shield](../../magic/spells/shield.md)*, *[ventriloquism](../../magic/spells/ventriloquism.md)*  
0 (at will)—*[arcane mark](../../magic/spells/arcane-mark.md)*, *[dancing lights](../../magic/spells/dancing-lights.md)*, *[detect magic](../../magic/spells/detect-magic.md)*, *[ghost sound](../../magic/spells/ghost-sound.md)* (DC 13), *[mage hand](../../magic/spells/mage-hand.md)*, *[message](../../magic/spells/message.md)*, *[prestidigitation](../../magic/spells/prestidigitation.md)**[, read magic](../../magic/spells/read-magic.md)*  


**Statistics**


**Str** 27, **Dex** 12, **Con** 21, **Int** 16, **Wis** 17, **Cha** 16  
**Base Atk** +16; **CMB** +25; **CMD** 36 (40 vs. trip)  
**Feats** Alertness, Flyby Attack, Hover, Greater Spell Focus (enchantment), Improved Initiative, Multiattack, Spell Focus (enchantment), [Weapon Focus (bite)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (bite).*  
**Skills** Bluff +22, Diplomacy +22, Fly +14, Heal +22, Linguistics +22, Perception +26, Sense Motive +26, Spellcraft +22, Survival +22  
**Languages** Common, Draconic, plus any 17 more  
**SQ** move sand  


**Special Abilities**


**Desert Wind (Su)** A juvenile or older brass dragon can call up the desert wind to serve him. This functions as *gust of wind*, but any creature in its path must make a Fortitude save (DC 23) or be blinded for 1d4 rounds by the sand.  

**Move Sand (Su)** A young or older brass dragon can move sand to excavate ruins or hide treasures. This functions as *move earth*, but it only affects sand. The dragon uses his HD in place of his caster level for this effect. This is equivalent to a 5th-level spell.  

**Sleep Breath (Su)** Instead of a line of fire, a brass dragon can breathe a 40 ft. cone of sleep gas. Creatures within the cone must succeed on a Will save or fall asleep for 1d6+7 rounds.
